:new: New project intention · #15 Formalizing "Sobolev spaces"

In this project we plan to formalize chapters 3-4-5-6-7 of Adam&Fournier's book "Sobolev spaces", building on the current Mathlib approach for Lp-spaces. We envision no interaction with AIs.

Registered by @fpvandoorn, @grunweg, @faenuccio
Areas: t-analysis, t-functional-analysis
